title: Randolph Genealogy Hub Claim
description: One atomic, sourced genealogical assertion submitted for corroboration. See Claims/README.md and docs/MYKV_SERVICE_DESIGN.md for the full model. This file documents the shape; tools/cid_registrar.py is the actual runtime validator (kept dependency-free, so this schema is not executed at CI time).

subject_cid.description: The individual this claim is about. Either a real, already-registered Canonical_ID, or a PENDING:<key> placeholder (lowercase, hyphenated) shared by every claim proposing the same not-yet-registered person.

object_cid.description: A second individual this claim relates the subject to — required for parent_child (the parent) and marriage (the spouse). Must be a real registered CID, or the literal 'UNK'.

assertion.description: Shape depends on claim_type. birth: {full_legal_name, namespace, birth_year, birth_state, birth_date?, birth_place?}. parent_child: {relationship: father|mother}. death: {death_date?, death_place?}. marriage: {marriage_date?, marriage_place?}. burial: {burial_place}. migration: {year?, location}. military: {unit?, rank?, service_dates?}. occupation: {description}.

source_id.description: A Source_Registry/ Source_ID if one exists, else 'UNK'.

submitted_by.description: Submitter identity (e.g. GitHub username). Two claims from the same submitted_by never corroborate each other — see §4.1 of the design doc.

status.description: Submitter always sets this to 'pending'. It is advisory only in Phase 2 — tools/cid_registrar.py recomputes confirmation from evidence_level and submitter independence fresh on every run rather than trusting a stored value.
